title: Photo at a "Red Cow" steak house restaurant
summary: A photo of a man holding a menu at a table in a steak house called Red Cow, with a large red cow butcher-cut diagram and the words RED COW on the wall behind him.

pictures.description: Photo inside a restaurant: a man in a red T-shirt and glasses sits on a dark sofa behind a wooden table, holding a menu. Behind him a grey wall shows a red cow drawn with butcher-cut lines and big letters RED COW; the cushions, menu and table runner also show a red cow and the words Red Cow Steak House. Wine glasses and plates are set on the table.
pictures.text_in_picture: HOT TASTY; RED COW; RED COW STEAK HOUSE
